law_record.title: Requirements for turning on highway (2)
law_record.text: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation_conditions: the subject is about to turn right or left, or otherwise change course
exceptions: none — the rule states expressly that it is observed regardless of the weather
residue: 'business or residential district' is a legal region class: a reading assumption that selects which of the two distances applies
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the signal must run continuously over the last 100 feet before the change in a business or residential district, and over the last 300 feet elsewhere
'continuously' — a signal switched on and off inside the distance does not satisfy the rule
the trace must cover at least the last 300 feet of approach for the longer case to be decidable
